"Safe Browser" is a filtered internet browser developed by Ashi Vered as an open-source project.
 The goal of the app is to provide a safe browsing experience by filtering websites, granting access only to pre-approved domains.
 It’s designed for anyone who wants a clean and safe online environment, free from harmful content.
 
 The development is entirely voluntary, with a vision to offer a reliable, simple, and easy-to-use tool, without ads, tracking, or any commercial interests.
 The source code for the app is available for viewing and download on GitHub:
 https://github.com/AshiVered/Android-Safe-Browser
 
 If you’ve enjoyed using the app, found it helpful, or have any suggestions for improvements, I’d love to hear from you!
 Feel free to contact me via email:
 ashivered.apps@gmail.com
 
 P.S. As mentioned, this app is developed entirely on a voluntary basis and without any ads. However, it requires a lot of time and effort to maintain and improve.
 If you’d like to support me and help continue the development of the app, I’d greatly appreciate any small donation.
